description.value:
♒ Aquarius is ascendant today. Your Cloth is awake and you have your Ascendant Boon for the whole day.

Any cold damage you deal forces a Fortitude save against your Cosmo DC; on a failure the creature is slowed 1. This is cumulative — at slowed 4 it is instead petrified in ice, which any critical hit shatters.

Your cold damage ignores cold resistance and treats cold immunity as resistance 10.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-class-features.Item.Ascendant Constellation]. Applied and removed by the module's sky tracker; a GM can also drag it on by hand.
